config.above_bound: point: estimate above the bound; clear: a mean above it by more than 2 MC SEs, or a P(sup) whose one-sided 97.5% Clopper-Pearson lower bound is above it
config.demand: iid round-half-up N(100, (100 cv)^2) clipped at 0; 5 train rows after
config.harm: arm 1 net reward minus the CTH arm's on the same path (positive: CTH lost); the negative of stage C's arm12_cth - arm1; the frozen arm's under plug_in only

laws.deterministic: every order arrives after exactly 2 periods

config.per_decision_check: max over decisions t > tau_1 + 1 of E[Pi_t] - A_t (at t = tau_1 + 1, Pi_t = A_1 by construction)

regimes.known: the true mean 100 and sd 100 cv given to the demand e-processes
regimes.plug_in: the frozen arm: demand e-process baseline = prefix mean and sd
